title: CobwebTM: Probabilistic Concept Formation for Lifelong and Hierarchical Topic Modeling
subcategory: lifelong / streaming hierarchical topic model via incremental concept formation
task: Lifelong (streaming) and hierarchical topic discovery without fixing the number of topics
problem: Neural topic models need heavy tuning and suffer catastrophic forgetting in streaming settings; classical probabilistic models lack flexibility for streaming data.
architecture: Adapts the Cobweb incremental probabilistic concept-formation algorithm to continuous document embeddings, building a concept hierarchy online; topic words per node via c-TF-IDF; only two user-set granularity parameters.
key_results: TweetNER: final C_V 0.741 vs 0.673 for re-fit HDBSCAN; TCD 0.000.
Stack Overflow: final C_V 0.613, ARI 0.997; Spatiotemporal News: final C_V 0.796, ARI 0.984.
strengths: No learnable parameters and no need to set the number of topics.
Supports dynamic topic creation and hierarchical organisation in one online procedure.
Stable topics across batches (near-zero centroid drift).

limitations.text: Topic words are extracted post hoc from documents at each node rather than generated during hierarchy construction.
Hierarchy quality is bounded by the pretrained document encoder.
Sensitive to document arrival order in non-stationary streams; globally optimal hierarchies are not guaranteed.
Memory and computation grow with the hierarchy in long-running deployments.

notes: Results averaged over three trials; initial batch 2,000 documents, then batches of 125.
